title: Determining the Link Between Dietary Patterns, Fecal Microbiome and Response to Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy
official: Determining the Link Between Dietary Patterns, Fecal Microbiome and Response to Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Patients
summary: This study explores the relationship between pre-treatment dietary patterns, fecal microbiome, and response to chemotherapy in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
conditions: Stage I Pancreatic Cancer AJCC v8
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \* Age ≥ 18 years with signed informed consent form

  * Patients must have a histological diagnosis of PDAC
  * Resectable or borderline resectable PDAC on imaging

Exclusion Criteria:

* \* Patients with locally advanced and metastatic stage IV PDAC

  * Patients who have already received or completed neoadjuvant chemotherapy for PDAC
  * Patients with active malignancy receiving systemic therapy
